name: manual_caabfb
claim: ~/.gbrain/config.json must have a 'database_url' key explicitly — ~/.gbrain/.env is NOT auto-sourced in non-interactive shells (Claude Code agents, launchd background jobs). Export the URL from .env into config.json directly, or gbrain fails with 'database_url is missing from config' in every non-interactive context.

decisions.notes: Discovered 2026-06-28 when gbrain broke in Claude Code agent session; ~/.gbrain/.env existed but was not loaded; fixed by writing database_url into config.json
